title: Home Purchase Financing — Good-Faith Partial Payments in Hardship
content:
**Hardship desk reference — the good-faith payment on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

## What it is

A good-faith payment is a one-time partial payment the borrower authorizes on their own loan toward a hardship deferment, and it is held in suspense like any payment smaller than one full installment. Being held in suspense, it does not mark any installment paid by itself.

## The borrower's own action: `make_good_faith_payment_f58b4303`

**Capability.** The borrower makes a good-faith partial payment on their own Hearthstone Home Finance loan by phone from their bank account: a one-time phone ACH payment of the stated amount. The payment is recorded today as a partial payment and held in the loan's suspense balance until suspense funds add up to a full installment; no installment is marked paid by it.

**How it is invoked.** This is the borrower's own tool. The agent unlocks `make_good_faith_payment_f58b4303` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to authorize the payment from their own bank account.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the borrower's Hearthstone Home Finance loan, as the agent reads it to the borrower from the loan record | identifier |
| `amount` | the payment amount, as the agent tells it to the borrower | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `status` "received", `loan_txn_id` (reference of the payment transaction), `payment_ref` (the payment confirmation number to keep), `loan_id`, `txn_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `payment_channel` ("phone_ach") and `suspense_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places — the funds held unapplied after the payment).

*Hypothetical reading:* a loan holding 40.00 in suspense that receives a good-faith payment of 260.00 shows a suspense balance of 300.00 on the receipt.
